name: ng-trace-q4k
command: md5sum engine/ng/draft_trace; for p in chat27 chat_code_py chat_code_c chat_list chat_math chat_story prompt64 chat_fix chat_edit; do ./engine/ng/draft_trace -m models/qwen35-0.8b-q4k-headq4k.pq --ids-file data/$p.ids -n 96 -K 8 || echo FAIL $p; done; ./engine/ng/draft_trace -m models/qwen35-0.8b-q4k-headq4k.pq --ids-file data/ctx2048.ids -n 64 -K 8 || echo FAIL ctx2048
